interface.name: mx_thumbnail_view_manager_v1

description.summary: draw toplevels into a shell's layer surfaces

interface.description: This interface lets a privileged shell client show live thumbnails of toplevels, drawn by the compositor onto the client's layer surfaces.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the manager object. Thumbnails already created stay valid.

request.name: get_thumbnail

description.summary: attach a toplevel's thumbnail to a layer surface

request.description:
Create a thumbnail that draws the contents of toplevel onto layer_surface.
The layer surface acts as an anchor providing depth and position (layer, output and geometry). The compositor draws the thumbnail and the fade instead of the client's content where they overlap, so the client should keep that part of its buffer fully transparent.
A toplevel handle that was already closed, or a layer surface that is already gone, gives an inert thumbnail: its requests do nothing.

interface.name: mx_thumbnail_view_v1

description.summary: a toplevel drawn onto a layer surface

interface.description: A thumbnail of a toplevel, drawn by the compositor onto a layer surface. The client drives its movement and fade by setting its properties each frame. Nothing is drawn before the first properties apply.

request.name: set_properties
request.description: x and y give the thumbnail's top-left corner in surface-local coordinates, scale is applied to the toplevel's size, and alpha is the opacity of the thumbnail and its fade. Double-buffered: they apply on the layer surface's next commit. A scale that is not positive, or a NaN alpha, is ignored; alpha is clamped to 0..1.
